data.review_body:
I am writing this public notice to highlight a severe failure by Temu regarding order fulfilment, consumer rights adherence, and customer support competence. 
I placed an order for a specific item, but the item delivered was entirely different from what was purchased. Upon immediately initiating a refund, I experienced a systemic failure in Temu's dispute resolution process: Deceptive Timelines: The automated system promised a merchant response within 1–3 business days. By the fourth day, no action had been taken. Direct communication with the seller yielded only identical, scripted, and empty promises. Failure to Provide Practicable Return Methods: Customer support insisted on emailing a printable return label. I explicitly informed an agent that I do not own printing facilities, and that the parcel's dimensions exceed my cars capacity. These logistical barriers were completely ignored. 

Evasive Delay Tactics: The resolution window was unilaterally extended from the advertised 1–3 business days to an unacceptable 9 business days. I was rigidly told to wait until 25th July just to contact them again, a tactic clearly designed to dismiss the consumer rather than resolve the issue. Temu’s customer service operates on rigid, automated scripts completely detached from practical problem-solving. A simple error has been dragged out unnecessarily due to corporate incompetence. Potential customers should be heavily cautioned: if your order is incorrect, expect zero meaningful support and exhausting delays. I demand that Temu immediately contact me to arrange a courier collection at their expense—requiring no printed label—and issue a full refund.

data.review_body:
I am a loyal Temu customer, but my experience has become increasingly disappointing.

My recent orders 
PO-004-12184301901432094 and 
PO-004-01189241119352094 
have once again suffered from long delivery delays. Unfortunately, this is not an isolated incident—it has happened with many of my previous orders as well.

What is even more frustrating is that I have also received damaged items and products that did not match their descriptions. In those cases, I was often required to return the items before receiving a refund, while I have seen many other customers receive refunds or compensation without having to go through the same process.

This inconsistent treatment makes me feel that customers are not treated equally. Loyal customers should not have to repeatedly experience delayed deliveries, damaged or inaccurate products, and a much more difficult refund process than others.
To make matters worse, Temu promised me a 5$ compensation, I accepted the offer, but I never received it. Making promises and then failing to honor them has seriously damaged my trust in Temu's customer service.

I hope Temu will review its customer service policies, ensure fair treatment for all customers, improve delivery reliability, and handle compensation requests consistently. At the moment, I am very disappointed with the overall experience.
data.review_headline: very disappointed with the overall experience.
